name: recall_callee_returns_none
about: The new code multiplies by a rate it gets from parse_rate, which lives in another file and returns None for a blank value. Nothing in the diff shows that; only the callee's definition does, so this is findable only when the context includes what the changed code calls.
diff:
diff --git a/pricing.py b/pricing.py
--- a/pricing.py
+++ b/pricing.py
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
 def apply_rate(price, row):
-    return price
+    rate = parse_rate(row["rate"])
+    return price * rate

head_sources.rates.py:
def parse_rate(text):
    return float(text) if text else None

findings.title: parse_rate returns None for a blank rate, so this multiplication raises TypeError
